chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Zayd ibn Ishaq, from Al-Hasan ibn Atiyya, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you have finished greeting the martyrs, go to the grave of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), place it in front of you, then pray whatever prayer comes to you.

key_terms.الشُّهَدَاءِ: The martyrs (specifically referring to those buried in the shrine complex)
key_terms.بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ: In front of you (facing the grave)
key_terms.قَبْرَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: The grave of Abu Abdillah (Imam Al-Husayn)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended procedure for praying at the grave of Imam Al-Husayn according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi outlines the specific ritual etiquette (adab) for Ziyarah, emphasizing the precedence of greeting the broader community of martyrs before focusing devotion on Imam Al-Husayn (as). It highlights the flexibility in the subsequent prayer, allowing the visitor to perform any voluntary (nafl) prayer, thereby integrating personal devotion with the sanctity of the shrine. This practice underscores the Shia tradition of viewing the grave as a spiritual focal point for direct communion with the Imam.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bi nIbrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najra, from Zayd Bin Is’haq, from Al Hassan Bin Atiyya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When you are free from the greeting upon the martyrs, so go to the grave of Abu Abdullahasws, and make it to be in front of you, then Pray Salaat, whatever comes to you’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu Najran from Zayd ibn Ishaq from al-Hassan ibn ‘Atiyyah who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
when you complete offering your greeting of peace to the martyrs then go the gravesite of abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, keep it in front of you and perform salat (prayer) as much as you want.”
